en-US.subtitle: Paste Text Snippets & Replies
en-US.promo: Keep your address, account numbers, email signature and canned replies in one place, then tap to paste them into any app from the Cutling keyboard.
en-US.release_notes: A small maintenance update. Nothing changes in how Cutling looks or works.

f1: Clipboard keyboard for snippets
Tap once to paste saved text into any app
f2: All you retype, in one place
Addresses, account numbers, emails and more
f3: Pick an icon, a color and an expiry date
f4: Switch to the keyboard, tap, and the text is in
f5: The right snippet comes up first
Suggestions match the field: email, phone, address

m1: Open it with a shortcut and paste into any app
m2: Everything you copied recently, ready to paste again
m3: The same snippets as on your iPhone, via iCloud
m5: In sync with iPhone and iPad
Snippets follow you; history stays on this Mac
